reasoning: Round 2. The supervisor's fact-checked findings changed four things and I accept all four after re-checking the filings: (a) the whole-company peer set is 6 names (VRT, MOD, CSW are segment-only) and Daikin's NTM is 19.5x CY-aligned, not the FY3/28 18.2x (MarketScreener page re-opened: 996.1 / 1,150 JPY at 21,170) - median 18.3x on peers.md figures, exit 22.5x at k=0.8; (b) k=0.8 on the EV/EBITDA leg too (14.1x two-peer median, own 20.6x -> 19.1x, weight 0.25); (c) tax 18.5%/19%/19% (FY25 19.2%, 9M26 18.0%, Q4 tax headwind on the call); (d) the bridge: I verified in the Q3 10-Q the supplier-financing balance 393.1 in accounts payable, the $270M funded QSF vs the $545M plan, and the 2026-09-25 non-binding $742.5M court estimate (the supervisor could not open it; I raise its confidence to medium but keep p 0.4); NCI at market 488. The call transcript confirms the volume case (over $8B of backlog dated 2027+, over $1B for 2028) and the margin cap (leverage 'low 20s', price ~1pt, 2027 price over inflation 20-30bp), which is exactly my round-1 volume-over-margin build, so the six drivers stay as they were (Americas FY27 +11.7%, margin +40bp = ~23.6% incrementals). Industry lane (Carrier, JCI, AAON, Vertiv, Lennox releases, AHRI, Dodge, Moody's, Kalshi) unchanged. FY27 adj. EPS ~17.84 sits +0.7% vs Street 17.71 and -1.4% vs whisper 18.10. Scenarios: downside widened to Americas -8% and -250bp margin (price is weaker than I had: ~1pt, not 1.5), giving a ~31% downside spread close to the stock's 30% realized vol; upside unchanged. Not driver-linked: none (no custom legs). Research target (12m) $429.9 (round 1 $442.22) - lower mainly on the bridge (supplier finance, NCI at market, asbestos) and the 19% tax rate; the P/E exit is unchanged at 22.5x.

model_inputs.structure_note: Quarterly driver-led set: 6 drivers (revenue and GAAP segment margin for Americas, EMEA, Asia Pacific, segments as reported) build 100% of segment revenue; corporate unallocated expense a cited per-quarter constant. Q1 FY2025-Q3 FY2026 reported (actual=7). FY2028 (the year the horizon NTM reads) is a normalising year: Americas growth fades to 6-7% as backlog burn normalises (>$1B already dated 2028, src 29). Value is carried by the NTM P/E horizon multiple (0.75) on the build's own GAAP earnings and an LTM EV/EBITDA cross-check (0.25, only 2 clean peers); the bridge carries supplier finance in net debt, NCI at market and asbestos as equity adjustments. No DCF (policy), no SOTP (single business model across regions).
model_inputs.gap_note: 1) P/E leg applies a peer multiple built on adjusted consensus EPS to model GAAP EPS; the GAAP-to-adjusted gap is ~$0.20/yr (~1.1%), so the leg is ~1% conservative. 2) Exit k = 0.8 on both legs (round 1's 0.71 on EV/EBITDA removed: no evidence). k=1.0 gives 23.7x and ~+4%, k=0.5 ~-6% (flag for Kilian). 3) My own NTM multiple is on peers.md's fiscal-year-blend basis (23.7x vs 18.3x); the supervisor's Nasdaq quarterly basis (23.96x vs 18.45x) gives 22.7x, +$4/share: I keep the table basis because every peer figure comes from it. 4) No extra long-dated haircut beyond the shrink (agree with the supervisor: it would double count). 5) Capacity ceiling not disclosed: I assume ~+11% shippable in FY27; a cap at +8% takes ~3% off. 6) Peer set 6 (flagged). 7) No financing events >= 20%: buybacks/M&A funded from FCF (YTD FCF $2.8B, src 1). 8) fair_value.value equals the engine base horizon value.

rows.pe_derivation: Derived estimate (aggregator, MarketScreener, opened 2026-11-02): the page shows last price 21,170 JPY (dated 2026-10-09 on the page), EPS FY3/27 996.1 and FY3/28 1,150 JPY, P/E 21.1x FY3/27 and 18.2x FY3/28 and EV/EBITDA 8.14x / 7.29x at its undated reference price 20,990 JPY. Period: NTM 2026-10-30 to 2027-10-30 = 5 months of FY3/27 (Nov-Mar) + 7 months of FY3/28 (Apr-Oct); NTM EPS = 5/12 x 996.1 + 7/12 x 1,150 = 415.0 + 670.8 = 1,085.9 JPY; P/E = 21,170 / 1,085.9 = 19.50x (at the page reference 20,990: 19.33x; page multiples time-weighted 5/12 x 21.1 + 7/12 x 18.2 = 19.41x). EPS basis UNVERIFIED: the page does not say adjusted or reported; Daikin reports under J-GAAP and publishes no adjusted EPS, so it is presumed reported J-GAAP. Price date 2026-10-09 vs the US peers' 2026-10-30 closes (no Oct-30 Daikin close available here). Neither alternative moves the six-peer median by more than 0.1x or the k=0.8 exit (22.7x). Confidence medium-low.
